mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Verona Community Park under a Waxing Gibbous moon, with temperatures holding at 59 degrees and an overnight low of 53 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona is currently hiring an Engineering Technician to oversee municipal construction projects through September 20. Additionally, residents are reminded that sewer and stormwater utilities are self-supporting, and new rates have been approved to cover rising maintenance costs.

Tomorrow, you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking further ahead, we have a packed schedule starting Tuesday with trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee, followed by more trivia and live music at Paddy Mac's, plus the downtown farmer's market on Wednesday.
On August 15, Verona police officers arrested a 44-year-old Fitchburg woman for a first offence O W I after she was found unresponsive in her vehicle.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Caramel Cashew. Culver's is currently closed, but they will reopen tomorrow at 10:00 AM, when you can try the Dark Chocolate PB Crunch.
